groups.name: pingcrm.security.rememberMe
groups.description: Remember-me login, which logs the user in again from a cookie when the session has ended

properties.name: pingcrm.security.rememberMe.key
properties.description: The key that remember-me cookies are signed with. Use a unique secret per installation, as anyone who knows it can create cookies that log in as any user.

properties.name: pingcrm.security.rememberMe.cookieName
properties.description: The name of the remember-me cookie.

properties.name: pingcrm.security.rememberMe.sameSite
properties.description: The SameSite attribute of the remember-me cookie.

properties.name: pingcrm.i18n.locales
properties.description: The languages the UI is translated into (grails-app/i18n/messages*.properties), as language tags. The first one is used when the browser asks for none of them.

properties.name: hibernate.jdbc.time_zone
properties.description: The time zone Hibernate uses when it binds and reads timestamps and times, as a time zone ID such as UTC. GORM passes settings under hibernate through to Hibernate. Ping CRM sets it to UTC, like the H2 URL, so that timestamps are written and read in UTC, whatever the default time zone of the JVM is. Defaults to the default time zone of the JVM.

properties.name: pingcrm.upload.maxFileSize
properties.description: The maximum size of an uploaded user photo, e.g. 512KB.

values.description: Only sent with requests from the application's own site.
Also sent when following a link to the application from another site.
Sent with all requests, also cross-site ones. Requires a secure cookie.
